messages.subject: Shopping Carrier
messages.text:
Hello, 

 I’d like to buy some of your butterfly clips for my mittens, but I currently live in an area that only receives packages from UPS or FedEx, and USPS does not ship to my place. Do you happen to use either of those carriers so that I might be able to put in an order?
 

 Thanks,
 Amanda

messages.subject: Re: Shopping Carrier
messages.text:
Hi Amanda,

I owe you a real apology for how long it took us to get back to you. A message from January deserves better than this, and I'm sorry.

Do you receive letters? We could ship a few clips with a stamped envelope.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
